newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 9.0/10.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 9.0/10.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 9.0/10.0 percent on Wednesday morning, dealers said.
They said ample rupiah supply was due to early central bank injection of some 850 billion rupiah.
Swap rates also eased on the back of the abundant rupiah supply in the money market, with overnight swap last quoted at 0.30/0.35 points. Longer-term swap rates eased as well.
One foreign bank dealer said operators seemed to expect similar ample liquidity on Thursday as indicated by relatively low tom/next rate at 0.45/0.49 points in the morning.
But he said the market was preparing itself for Friday on a possible repeat of tight conditions seen in the last two Fridays, coupled with the month-end factor and weekly tax payments.
Dealers said one-week money edged down to 12.75/13.00 percent from 13.5 percent on Tuesday.
The average overnight interbank rate on Tuesday was 9.89 percent, compared with 10.2 percent on Monday.
